intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Nerelle is floating on her back, frowning at the sky.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “A courtier asked whether I was thinking like a mermaid or a princess today.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “That the question was missing several options. He did not have time for the list.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “At present, I am thinking like someone who wants lunch and suspects the gulls of plotting.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Oh, that is perfect. It is technically an answer, and he will hate it.”

options.labelText: “It’s a fair question, though. Which one do you feel like more?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “You and the courtier should meet. You could split the difference.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I have never once been improved by being halved.”
